title: Differential Voting: Loss Functions For Axiomatically Diverse Aggregation of Heterogeneous Preferences
reasoning: The paper investigates the normative and axiomatic foundations of preference aggregation in RLHF for Large Language Models. It explicitly treats the selection of loss functions as a normative design decision, evaluating them against social choice ethics criteria (axioms) such as the Condorcet winner criterion and Pareto optimality to ensure principled value alignment.
